name: Phaarmasia Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Phaarmasia Ltd is engaged in manufacturing and marketing of Cosmetics, Oral Contraceptive Pills (OCP) and Combipack with Iron Tablets
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company provides various therapeutic dosage combinations for Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and also for exports. In FY20, company became a Sick Industrial Company under SICA and was referred to BIFR.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 80.9 to 46.6 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 5.08 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.10% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -10.7% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.83 Cr.
